# 14 Render destroy markers and box-group backgrounds

## Outcome

`renderSequenceToSVG` renders a `<path class="siren-destroy-mark" data-siren-id="{participantId}">`
X-mark at each `PositionedDestroyMark`, and a `<g class="siren-box" data-siren-id="{id}">`
background rect (+ optional label) for each `PositionedBox`, painted before (visually behind) the
participant boxes/lifelines/messages it contains.

## Acceptance criteria

- [ ] A destroyed participant's lifeline renders with an X-mark at its truncation point and no
  bottom `<g class="siren-participant">`.
- [ ] A `create`d participant renders exactly one `<g class="siren-participant">` (at its creation
  point), not two.
- [ ] Each `PositionedBox` renders one `<g class="siren-box">` with a background `<rect>` behind
  everything else in its region — paint order verified (the box's `<g>` appears before its member
  participants'/messages' elements in the SVG document, so it doesn't visually cover them).
- [ ] A `box`'s optional label text renders via `textContent` only.

## Test seam

`renderSequenceToSVG(diagram: PositionedSequenceDiagram): SVGSVGElement` — component test under
jsdom, extending ticket 09's test file.
